There are 7 days in a week, so 3 weeks is \(3 \times 7 = 21\) days. Each painter works for \( \frac{3}{8} \) of a day each day. Therefore, the total time one painter spent working over 3 weeks is:
\[ \text{Total time per painter} = 21 \text{ days} \times \frac{3}{8} \text{ day/day} = \frac{63}{8} \text{ days} \]
Since there are 24 hours in a day, we convert this to hours:
\[ \text{Hours per painter} = \frac{63}{8} \times 24 = 63 \times 3 = 189 \text{ hours} \]
So, each painter worked 189 hours.

- Half of the total area is 1 unit of work.
